name: Smart Video Scheduler
description: A content calendar for scheduled social posts. The Calendar tab lists posts you have scheduled to YouTube, TikTok and Instagram, Schedule opens the Publish to Social window ready to schedule, and Analytics shows counts of your scheduled, published and failed posts.
shortDescription: Schedule posts to YouTube, TikTok and Instagram and see them on a calendar.
fullDescription: Smart Video Scheduler (#/smart-video-scheduler, also opened by #/brightbean) lets you schedule social posts and follow them. Calendar (open by default) lists your scheduled posts grouped by day, each with its time, platform and status (Scheduled, Publishing, Published or Failed). A failed post shows the reason, a published post has a 'View post' link when the platform returned one, and a post that has not started publishing has a Cancel button. Cancelled posts are hidden. Schedule has a 'Schedule a post' button that opens the same Publish to Social window the studios use, set to schedule: you choose the media, thumbnail, copy, account and a time (1 hour, 3 hours, tomorrow 9 AM, or a date and time you pick up to 90 days ahead). Analytics shows counts of scheduled, published, failed and total posts, with a count per platform. It does not show views or engagement from the platforms. The page refreshes every 30 seconds while it is open. Scheduling needs you to be signed in with SmartVideo AI access, a Muapi key added in Settings, and a connected YouTube, TikTok or Instagram account.
bestFor: Planning posts ahead for YouTube, TikTok and Instagram and checking whether they went out.
whenToUse: You want a post to go out later instead of now.
You want to see what is scheduled, published or failed.
You want to cancel a post that has not started publishing.
whenToUseAnother: Use the Publish to Social button in a studio (Video Studio, Image Studio and others) to publish right away.
Use Video Studio (#/video) or Image Studio (#/image) to make the content first.
Use Library (#/library) to find content you already made.
keyFeatures: Calendar tab: your scheduled posts grouped by day with status, errors and links
Schedule tab: opens the Publish to Social window in schedule mode
Analytics tab: counts of scheduled, published and failed posts
Cancel a post that has not started publishing
The AI thumbnail you pick is applied to the post (Instagram cover, or the YouTube thumbnail after upload)

featureExplanations.explanation: Opens by default. Lists your scheduled posts by day with time, platform and status. Failed posts show the reason; published posts link to the post when the platform gave a link.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: To see what is coming up and what happened to past posts.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Shows only your own posts. Cancelled posts are hidden. There is no calendar grid or drag to reschedule; to change a time, cancel the post and schedule it again.

featureExplanations.explanation: Click 'Schedule a post' to open the Publish to Social window in schedule mode. Choose media, thumbnail, copy, an account and when to publish, then click Schedule.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: To queue a post for later.
featureExplanations.inputRequired: A public https media URL, a connected account, and a Muapi key added in Settings.
featureExplanations.restrictions: The time must be at least a minute away and within 90 days. You can have up to 100 pending posts. Your Muapi key is stored encrypted only until your posts have published, then removed.

featureExplanations.explanation: Shows counts of scheduled, published, failed and total posts and a count per platform.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: A quick view of how many posts are queued and how many went out.
featureExplanations.restrictions: These are your own scheduling counts. Views, likes and other platform performance are not shown.

featureExplanations.explanation: Cancels a post that is still Scheduled. Once a post is Publishing it cannot be cancelled.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: To stop a post going out.

howToUse: 1. Open #/smart-video-scheduler (or #/brightbean). 2. Click 'Schedule' then 'Schedule a post' (or the button on an empty Calendar). 3. In the window, add your media, thumbnail and copy, pick an account on the Platform step, choose a time under 'When', and click Schedule. 4. Open Calendar to see the post and its status. 5. Click Cancel on a post that has not started publishing if you change your mind.
howToSteps: Add media, thumbnail and copy, and pick an account on the Platform step.
Choose a time under 'When' and click Schedule.
Open Calendar to follow the post's status.
gettingStarted: Add your Muapi key in Settings.
Connect a YouTube, TikTok or Instagram account from the Platform step of the Publish to Social window.
Schedule a post a few hours out, then check it on the Calendar.
optionalInputs: Description, tags and other platform options
modelCapabilities: The page itself calls no AI model. The Publish to Social window can create a thumbnail and enhance copy with AI.
outputs: A scheduled post that publishes at the chosen time
A status on the Calendar for each post
limitations: Only YouTube, TikTok and Instagram are supported.
Media must be a public https URL.
Posts can be scheduled from one minute to 90 days ahead, up to 100 pending at a time.
Posts cannot be edited or rescheduled; cancel and schedule again.
A post that is interrupted while publishing is marked Failed and is not retried automatically, so check the platform before scheduling it again.
TikTok has no thumbnail option; the thumbnail is applied to Instagram and YouTube only.
Analytics shows counts only, not views or engagement.
The selected tab is not remembered; the page always opens on Calendar.

limitationDetails.impact: You cannot change the time or copy of a scheduled post.
limitationDetails.workaround: Cancel the post and schedule it again.

limitationDetails.impact: A post marked Failed with 'Publishing was interrupted' may or may not have reached the platform.
limitationDetails.workaround: Check the platform, then schedule it again only if it is missing.

limitationDetails.impact: You cannot see views or engagement here.

troubleshooting: Schedule says to add a Muapi key: add it in Settings, then try again.
Schedule asks you to sign in or upgrade: scheduling needs a signed-in account with SmartVideo AI access.
A post shows Failed: the reason is shown under it; fix the cause and schedule it again.
I do not see a post: cancelled posts are hidden, and the list refreshes every 30 seconds.

commonProblems.problem: A scheduled post did not go out
commonProblems.whyItHappens: The platform or Muapi rejected it, or publishing was interrupted.
commonProblems.howToFix: Open Calendar and read the reason under the post, then schedule it again.

commonProblems.problem: Thumbnail not on my YouTube video
commonProblems.whyItHappens: YouTube thumbnails are applied after the video is live and can fail separately.
commonProblems.howToFix: The post still published; set the thumbnail in YouTube Studio.

exampleWorkflows.title: Schedule a video for tomorrow
steps: Add your video URL, pick a thumbnail and write the title.
Pick your account, choose 'Tomorrow 9 AM', and click Schedule.
Open Calendar to confirm it is Scheduled.

useCases.title: Queue posts ahead
useCases.description: Line up posts for the week without publishing them one by one.
steps: Schedule each post with its own time
useCases.expectedOutput: Posts publish at their times and show Published, or Failed with a reason.

faqs.question: Can I schedule social posts here?
faqs.answer: Yes, for YouTube, TikTok and Instagram. Click 'Schedule a post', choose an account and a time, and click Schedule.

faqs.question: How do I connect my social accounts?
faqs.answer: From the Platform step of the Publish to Social window, connect YouTube, TikTok or Instagram.

faqs.question: Do I need a Muapi key?
faqs.answer: Yes. Add it in Settings. It is stored encrypted only until your scheduled posts have published, then removed.

faqs.question: Can I edit or reschedule a post?
faqs.answer: Not yet. Cancel it and schedule it again.

faqs.question: What is #/brightbean?
faqs.answer: Another address for the same Smart Video Scheduler page.

glossary.Content calendar: A plan of which posts go out on which days.
glossary.Scheduling: Choosing a future date and time for a post to be published.

tips: Schedule at least a few minutes ahead.
Pick a thumbnail before scheduling; it is applied when the post goes out.
Check the Calendar after the time passes to confirm it published.
bestPractices: Use a public https media URL that will still exist at the scheduled time.
Check Failed posts on the platform before scheduling them again.
